g.text: Sampling beach pebbles: positions, measurement and shape
(a) Plan of the beach stretch (not to scale)
Roundness scale: compare each pebble with these
From the start marker, place the quadrat every 10 m along the
line and take the pebble under its marked corner each time (a
fixed rule, not a chosen pebble).
Measure that pebble’s longest axis in millimetres with the same
Record size and roundness class separately against the position,
using the same scale. If no pebble is under the corner, record
“no suitable pebble” rather than choosing another.
Roundness scale (use the same scale for every pebble)
Distance north from the first site (m)
